definitionBean.title: Relationship between Zeros and Coefficients
definitionBean.definition: The zeros of a polynomial are the values for which the value of the polynomial becomes zero, and they have a definite relationship with the coefficients.
definitionBean.explanation: For a quadratic polynomial ax² + bx + c, if α and β are the zeros, then: Sum of zeros α + β = -b/a and Product of zeros αβ = c/a. Similar formulas exist between zeros and coefficients for cubic polynomials as well.
importantPoints: This relationship is also used to form a polynomial: x² - (α + β)x + αβ
There are three relationships in a cubic polynomial (sum, sum of product of zeros taken two at a time, product)

definitionBean.title: Quadratic Polynomials
definitionBean.definition: A polynomial of degree 2 is called a quadratic polynomial. General form: p(x) = ax² + bx + c, where a ≠ 0.
definitionBean.explanation: The graph of a quadratic polynomial is always a parabola. Its graph can intersect the x-axis at a maximum of two points, which are its zeros. The shape of the parabola opens upwards or downwards depending on whether 'a' is positive or negative.
importantPoints: Intersects the x-axis at a maximum of 2 points
Opens upwards if a > 0, and downwards if a < 0

parts.statement: Find the zeros of the quadratic polynomial x² - 2x - 8 and verify the relationship between the zeros and the coefficients.
parts.explanation: Polynomial p(x) = x² - 2x - 8nSplitting the middle term:nx² - 4x + 2x - 8 = 0nx(x - 4) + 2(x - 4) = 0n(x - 4)(x + 2) = 0nTherefore, x = 4 or x = -2 (Zeros α = 4, β = -2)nnVerification:n1) Sum of zeros: α + β = 4 + (-2) = 2nFrom formula (-b/a) = -(-2)/1 = 2 (Verified)nn2) Product of zeros: αβ = 4 × (-2) = -8nFrom formula (c/a) = -8/1 = -8 (Verified)

parts.statement: Find a quadratic polynomial with the given numbers as the sum and product of its zeros respectively -3 and 2.
parts.explanation: Let the zeros of the quadratic polynomial be α and β.nGiven:nSum of zeros (α + β) = -3nProduct of zeros (αβ) = 2nnFormula for quadratic polynomial:np(x) = x² - (α + β)x + αβnp(x) = x² - (-3)x + 2np(x) = x² + 3x + 2nnTherefore, the required quadratic polynomial is x² + 3x + 2.

parts.statement: Find the zeros of the quadratic polynomial 4s² - 4s + 1 and verify the relationship between the zeros and the coefficients.
parts.explanation: Polynomial p(s) = 4s² - 4s + 1n4s² - 2s - 2s + 1 = 0n2s(2s - 1) - 1(2s - 1) = 0n(2s - 1)(2s - 1) = 0nTherefore, s = 1/2, 1/2nnVerification:nSum = 1/2 + 1/2 = 1, and -b/a = -(-4)/4 = 1nProduct = (1/2) × (1/2) = 1/4, and c/a = 1/4

parts.statement: Find the zeros of the polynomial 3x² - x - 4 and verify the relationship between the zeros and the coefficients.
parts.explanation: Polynomial p(x) = 3x² - x - 4n3x² - 4x + 3x - 4 = 0nx(3x - 4) + 1(3x - 4) = 0n(3x - 4)(x + 1) = 0nTherefore, x = 4/3 or x = -1nnVerification:nSum = 4/3 + (-1) = 1/3, and -b/a = -(-1)/3 = 1/3nProduct = (4/3) × (-1) = -4/3, and c/a = -4/3
